"""Main integration of API validation only; native GPU bias remains unenabled."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
W = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012')
P = B / 'xe-v0143-logit-bias-source-v3'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('api_merge_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)

with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out = B / 'xe-v0143-api-bias-and-save-deadline-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    r = dict(active=True, complete=False, passed=False, scope='SourceOnly API validation/transport and retry correction',
             gpu_executed=False, native_bias_enabled=False, controller_sha256=m.sha(__file__), commands=[])
    def save(): (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')
    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = dict(PATH='/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')
    def cmd(label, args):
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, args, env, W, wall=60, cpu=60, text_cap=8 << 20,
                              total_cap=64 << 20, file_cap=64 << 20, rss_cap=2 << 30)
        r.setdefault('evidence', {})[label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] == 0, label
    try:
        assert m.sha(P / 'logit-bias-v3.patch') == '1b13d413befe3378542492197c8549a80f6ddd6adb46b17a3313931c13354bb2'
        for line in (P / 'SHA256SUMS').read_text().splitlines():
            h, path = line.split('  ', 1)
            assert m.sha(P / path) == h, path
        protected = ['src/program/generate.cpp', 'src/core/verify.cpp', 'src/kernels/xe/sampler.cpp',
                     'include/strata/core/verify.hpp', 'include/strata/kernels/sampler.hpp', 'CMakeLists.txt']
        r['native_before'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in protected}
        patch = (P / 'logit-bias-v3.patch').read_text()
        a = patch.index('--- a/serve/server.py\n')
        b = patch.index('--- /dev/null\n', a)
        header, *hunks = patch[a:b].split('@@ -')
        # Do not alter fatal/native sampling behavior as part of a validation-only port.
        patch = header + ''.join('@@ -' + h for h in hunks if not h.startswith(('482,', '672,')))
        file = out / 'api-only-hunks.patch'
        file.write_text(patch)
        r['api_patch_sha256'] = m.sha(file)
        cmd('apply-check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'apply', '--check', str(file)])
        cmd('apply', ['/usr/bin/git', 'apply', str(file)])
        for p in ['serve/logit_bias.py', 'serve/test_logit_bias.py']:
            assert not (W / p).exists()
            text = (P / 'after' / p).read_text()
            if p.endswith('test_logit_bias.py'):
                text = text[:text.index('    def test_no_candidate_terminal_status')]
                text = text.replace('import io\n', '').replace('import queue\n', '').replace('import threading\n', '')
                text = text.replace('from unittest import mock\n', '').replace('ByteTokenizer, EngineDied, MockEngine', 'ByteTokenizer, MockEngine')
            (W / p).write_text(text)
        p = W / 'serve/session_save_retry.py'
        text = p.read_text()
        old = '            if not same_process():\n                raise last_error\n            try:'
        assert text.count(old) == 1
        p.write_text(text.replace(old, '            if not same_process() or time.monotonic() >= deadline:\n'
                                 '                raise last_error\n            try:'))
        p = W / 'serve/test_session_save_retry.py'
        text = p.read_text()
        anchor = '    def test_persistent_pressure_expires_without_another_save(self):'
        assert text.count(anchor) == 1
        test = '''    def test_deadline_crossed_during_telemetry_does_not_dispatch_retry(self):
        error = refused()
        self.engine.session_file.side_effect = error

        def late_telemetry():
            self.clock.now = retry.SETTLE_SECONDS
            return 5000

        with mock.patch.object(retry, 'available_mib', side_effect=late_telemetry):
            with self.assertRaises(SessionRefused) as got:
                retry.session_file(self.service, 'save', 'same.bin', SessionRefused)
        self.assertIs(got.exception, error)
        self.assertEqual(self.engine.session_file.call_count, 1)

'''
        p.write_text(text.replace(anchor, test + anchor))
        assert all(m.sha(W / p) == h for p, h in r['native_before'].items())
        cmd('diff-check', ['/usr/bin/git', 'diff', '--check'])
        r['changed_pins'] = {p: m.sha(W / p) for p in ['serve/server.py', 'serve/logit_bias.py',
            'serve/test_logit_bias.py', 'serve/session_save_retry.py', 'serve/test_session_save_retry.py']}
        r['passed'] = True
    except BaseException as error:
        r['error'] = repr(error)
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, complete=owner.active is None)
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ['passed', 'error']}))
